t: Head Tracking for Desktop VR Displays using the WiiRemote

q.x: Johnny Lee was the guy with the awesome Wii Controller demos back in 2007 (can't believe it's been that long). [link]

desc: Using the infrared camera in the Wii remote and a head mounted sensor bar (two IR LEDs), you can accurately track the location of your head and render view dependent images on the screen. This effectively transforms your display into a portal to a virtual environment.  The display properly reacts to head and body movement as if it were a real window creating a realistic illusion of depth and space
